operator_notes: Original acquisition notes are required to resolve panel identifiers, start times, orientation, weather, calibration, acquisition method, firmware revision, and processing history. Unknown values have not been inferred from the report publication date or current firmware.
notes: Compare tracked vs fixed under sequential protocol

parameter_sources.protocol: Sequential comparison described in the original report; acquisition notes for these CSVs were not supplied.
parameter_sources.duration_s: Last minus first CSV timestamp; both records span 10800 seconds.
parameter_sources.load_ohms: V/I in both CSVs is approximately 47 ohms, consistent with the original report; fitted component not independently checked.
parameter_sources.panel_rated_w: Nominal design rating (6 V, 150 mA), not a verified identifier or rating for the acquired panels.
parameter_sources.shunt_ohms: Configured design value from firmware/original report; fitted shunt and calibration not independently checked.
